name: ethereal_elk_finds_vivien_in_graveyard_no_shuffle
notes: P5b5749e9f4 G4. Printed: '... search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Vivien, Nature's Avenger ... If you search your library this way, shuffle.' The Elk enters, accepts the may and searches the graveyard only (option 2): Vivien goes from the graveyard to hand and, the library not having been searched, it is NOT shuffled: its order is exactly as it was.
